headline: Colombian Peso Rises Ahead of Central Bank Meeting Amid Rate Hike Expectations
summary: The Colombian peso traded at 3,166.91 per US dollar ahead of a Bank of the Republic meeting where an interest rate increase is expected.
why: Anticipation of central bank interest rate hikes frequently influences currency valuations and fixed-income positioning.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Expectations of higher benchmark interest rates attract capital inflows, supporting currency strength.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Anticipation of a central bank interest rate hike heightened demand for local currency assets, driving exchange rate movements.
